entities.name: Minotaur
entities.description: A species of humanoid bull creatures found on many planes, fierce in combat and often very prideful.

entities.name: Hurloon Minotaurs
entities.description: Spiritual, storytelling minotaurs of Hurloon in the Domains on Dominaria, devastated in the Phyrexian Invasion.

entities.name: Talruum Minotaurs
entities.description: Aggressive, vain minotaurs of the Talruum Mountains in Jamuraa who worship the war god Torahn.

entities.name: Anaba Minotaurs
entities.description: A spiritual and wise minotaur tribe on Ulgrotha, living in the Kher Ridge of the Koskun Mountains.

entities.name: Spiritcrafters
entities.description: A primarily male sect of Anaba Shamans who worked divination and spoke with spirits.

entities.name: Ordruun
entities.description: The most prominent line of minotaurs on Ravnica, sworn to the Boros Legion and the Wojeks.

entities.name: Taysir
entities.description: A figure on Ulgrotha who attacked Sandruu, enslaved the Anaba, was killed by Feroz, then revived by the Spiritcrafters as a kind ally.

entities.name: Sandruu
entities.description: An Anaba planeswalker who attracted the ire of Taysir.

entities.name: Feroz
entities.description: A friend of the exiled Sandruu who fought and eventually killed Taysir; wed by an Anaba along with Serra.

entities.name: Serra
entities.description: A planeswalker on Ulgrotha whose followers were on peaceful terms with the Anaba.

entities.name: Terrent Amese
entities.description: Said to have created the minotaurs on Dominaria around 2300-2600 AR.

entities.name: Mogis
entities.description: The god most Theros minotaurs revere as their primary god.

entities.name: Torahn
entities.description: A violent war god worshipped by the Talruum minotaurs.

entities.name: Phyrexian Invasion of Dominaria
entities.description: The invasion that devastated the Hurloon and Talruum minotaur tribes.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: A plane with many minotaur nations including Hurloon, Talruum, Mirtiin and Stahaan.

entities.name: Ulgrotha
entities.description: Plane home to the Anaba and Labyrinth Minotaurs.

entities.name: Boros Legion
entities.description: Ravnican guild to which the Ordruun minotaurs have vowed allegiance.

events.summary: Before the Conflux, minotaurs lived in the canyons of Naya; afterwards they roam all of Alara.
events.quote: Before the Conflux , the minotaurs inhabited the deep canyons of Naya , but now roam the width and breadth of Alara freely

events.summary: Hurloon minotaurs came to Northern Aerona from Stahaan after being driven out by glaciers.
events.quote: These minotaurs arrived in Northern Aerona from Stahaan centuries ago after being forced from their homelands by the encroaching glaciers .

events.summary: The Hurloon and Talruum were devastated in the Phyrexian Invasion.
events.quote: The Hurloon tribe, along with the Talruum, was devastated in the Phyrexian Invasion of Dominaria .

events.summary: After the Invasion the Talruum broke with their xenophobia to search for surviving minotaurs.
events.quote: In the wake of the Invasion, the Talruum broke with their traditional xenophobia to search for other surviving minotaurs along with the Hurloon.

events.summary: Taysir attacked the returning Sandruu and defeated him.
events.quote: Taysir defeated Sandruu but was then attacked by a friend of the exiled planeswalker, Feroz .

events.summary: Taysir enslaved the Anaba and summoned an earthquake against Feroz, killing many Anaba and destroying the pictoglyph caves.
events.quote: Taysir enslaved the Anaba, and many of them were killed when Taysir summoned an earthquake against Feroz, which also destroyed the pictoglyph caves.

events.summary: Feroz killed Taysir; the Spiritcrafters preserved his body and revived him as an ally two centuries later.
events.quote: Feroz eventually killed Taysir, but the Spiritcrafters preserved his body and spent two centuries calming his soul, reviving him as a kind and humble ally.

relations.quote: The Ordruun have vowed allegiance to the Boros Legion and the Wojeks .
An Anaba planeswalker named Sandruu attracted the ire of Taysir, who attacked him when Sandruu was returning home.
Minotaurs mostly revere Mogis as their primary god.
Their religion involves the worship of Torahn, a violent war god.
